about: Features with status works or partial in docs/features.json that no film shows, each with the reason. docs/videos/coverage.mjs accepts these and fails on any other works/partial feature without a chapter. Stubs and removed features are never filmed and need no entry.

features.leads.kanban: No pipeline board on the leads page in the current build: the board component is used only by Tasks (features.json says a toggle exists; the inventory should be corrected). Film it once the board ships.
features.inbox.plivo-inbound: Plivo is not a launch provider (owner decision 2026-10-15: Twilio only).
features.inbox.send-document: API only: no screen sends a stored document by message yet.
features.payments.link-invoice: API only: no control in the payments screens links an advance to an invoice.
features.ai.suggest-replies: API only: no screen calls it.
features.ai.invoice-generate: API only: no screen calls the AI invoice draft.
features.ai.bi-forecast: API only: no screen links to the cash-flow forecast or revenue pulse.
features.marketing.suggestions: API only: no page links to the AI marketing suggestions.
features.marketing.legacy-campaigns: Older duplicate of Marketing > Campaigns (/campaigns); left out so the films show one way to run a campaign.
features.notifications.push: Nothing to show: the push queue exists, but no app receives a push yet (the driver app has no push SDK).
features.landing.reviews: The reviews section is written copy, not quotes from real customers; it is not filmed until the quotes are verified.
